BL-1679 — the land step drops its land-replay/<ticket>-<sha> scratch branch on every failure path but returns it on success for QA to check out and push from, and nothing deletes it afterwards (149 refs on this repository, 2026-08-29..2026-09-20, 105 of them already on origin/main), while pre_qa_gate_gather_lib's role-branches reads each pipeline role's CURRENT worktree HEAD instead of the roster branch - so for the minute QA's checkout sits on the scratch branch every other seat's pre-QA ancestry gate reads it as swarmforge-QA and the replay commit as a stranded ticket commit (hardener self-check 2026-09-21 13:46-13:47 local: PRE_QA_GATE_FAIL ancestry BL-1641 cf7d8c460f stranded on land-replay/BL-1641-9097b85058); a land's scratch artifacts are never a parcel lineage - the gate reads the roster branch and warns on a drifted checkout, and a landed replay's ref is swept once its tip is on origin/main
